entities.summary: Keamogetse Sadie Kenosi is a Botswana boxer. She competed in the women's featherweight event at the 2020 Summer Olympics. She lost to Karriss Artingstall of Great Britain in the first round. Originally a netball player, Kenosi began boxing in 2015. She competed at the 2019 World Championships and won a gold medal at the 2019 African Games.
